title: Linear Convergence of Diffusion Models Under the Manifold Hypothesis
tldr_zh: d 维流形数据上，DDPM 系数（冻结后验均值）反向 SDE 达 KL-ε² 只需 Õ(d/ε²) 步，对内在维数线性且 sharp；指数积分器必付 D 代价
tldr_en: On d-dimensional manifold data, the DDPM discretization (freezing E[X0|Xt]) reaches ε²-KL in Õ(d/ε²) steps—linear in intrinsic dimension and sharp—while exponential integrators pay for ambient D.
key_numbers: KL(Ŷ_{T−δ}‖X_δ) ≲ ε_score² + D e^{-2T} + κ + dκ²(K−L)(log δ^{-1}+C) (Thm 10, Eq. 8)
Iteration complexity K = Õ(d/ε²) via Cor. 11; KL rate O(d/K), TV O(√(d/K)) (Sec. 6)
Prior intrinsic-dimension complexities: d⁴ (Li–Yan 2024), d³ (Azangulov et al. 2024) (Sec. 1)
